clips.title: The story
paras: Maestra's Post is a small Alliance settlement in western Ashenvale, perched along the road northwest of Astranaar and south of the Ruins of Ordil'Aran. Guarded by night elven Sentinels and hosting a rare human presence in Kalimdor's ancient forest, it serves as a forward watch against encroaching threats.

Positioned under the canopy of western Ashenvale, Maestra's Post consists of a slender night elven tower and an open lodge. It sits as an essential waypoint for travelers marching between the coast of Darkshore and the larger hub of Astranaar. Despite its tranquil elven architecture, the outpost stands perpetually on edge. The local Sentinels keep a wary eye on the surrounding wilderness, where corrupted furbolg stir and nearby Horde movements constantly threaten the Alliance's supply lines.
